wiz_intro: Ahhh... So the winds have brought you back, young one. It has been an age since you last walked these halls.
Knowledge sleeps upon my shelves, waiting for curious minds. Seek the shelf, and awaken the wisdom within.
wiz_after: Still wandering without wisdom, are we?
Return when the dust of the shelves has clung to your hands and your mind hums with what you’ve learned.
wiz_books_intro: Ah, you found the tomes, but did their secrets find you?
Return once your eyes have danced through their pages and your thoughts have grown sharper.
wiz_return_after_book1: So, the first book yields its knowledge to you. The Elements themselves whisper your name now.
Your next task awaits: seek out Book II the art of creation, where elements become one.
wiz_return_after_book2: The second tome lies conquered! You now grasp the power of combination and the birth of compounds.
Yet knowledge untested is knowledge wasted. Go to my desk face the Trial of Properties.
wiz_return_after_desk: You triumphed over the Tials of Properties! Your understanding of properties now rivals that of seasoned scholars.
But the path stretches onward. Venture to Book III where mixtures weave the threads of chaos and order.
wiz_return_after_book3: Marvelous! You’ve mastered the lessons of mixtures few have come this far.
Your foundation is strong. Ahead lie experiments that separate the skilled from the wise.
wiz_return_after_separation: You’ve proven your dexterity in the art of separation precision and patience your allies.
Our experiments grow ever more subtle. Your next trial concerns the twin blades of Accuracy and Precision handle them with care.
wiz_return_after_accuracy: Ah, I can see clarity in your eyes the balance between truth and exactness has revealed itself to you.
Now, journey forth to find Christofe, my apprentice in the eastern halls. He will teach you the weight of the world the Lesson of Density.
